policy: New Zealand is greenfield and has no incumbent population, so parity, export_surface, and target_surface are absent. Public NZ facts and Treasury oracles govern the build. Gates whose thresholds are D1 method-card items (MC15 fit tolerances, effective sample size, weight ratio) stay not_applicable with the reason 'awaiting D1'; macro_realism waits on packaged evidence and reviewed bands; donor support and release input coverage wait on the transport code that is to produce their evidence. Thresholds are never borrowed from Belgium, the US, the UK or Armenia and never set from a candidate. Active reference, profile, weights, nonzero, formula-ownership, and nonnegative gates fail closed.

gates.not_applicable: awaiting D1: the ex-ante NZ per-family tolerances (method card MC15) are not yet ruled, and Chronicle has not yet supplied the complete cell-expanded NZ target inventory or covariance. Belgium and shared runner defaults may not silently govern New Zealand.
gates.notes: Activate with explicit NZ policy after the target harvest. Every hard family must report separately so an easy demographic family cannot hide a weak income or programme family.

gates.not_applicable: awaiting D1: reviewed fact-specific tolerances are not yet ruled, and the complete Chronicle NZ fact rows, projection basis to tax year 2026-27, and uncertainty are not yet bound.
gates.notes: Activate at country and region levels only after every hard reference resolves. Consume table leaves or totals, never both as independent targets.
Every table-level authoring contract must be replaced by generated cell-pinned Chronicle references with direct, prepared, or engine-derived bindings; every activated reference must enter the matrix.

The active national profile must retain every family of the D1 MC5 calibration set (target_references.json). Accommodation Supplement and Working for Families references are held out (holdout_references.json) and must never be required here. Treasury model outputs (DistributionExplorer, IncomeExplorer) and official Budget reform scores are validation oracles, never calibration targets.

gates.not_applicable: awaiting its evidence: no Microcosm code yet emits the donor-artifact authentication receipt (the transport CREATE kernel, package G5a) or the per-module Axiom input-closure verdict (package G4), so no gate binding can read this evidence; activate it with a binding before any candidate release.
gates.notes: Authenticate the exact Build P donor artifact and close every declared Frame/Axiom input. A missing substantive root input of any module bound in axiom_rules_bindings.json is a build failure, never an engine default.

gates.not_applicable: awaiting its evidence: no Microcosm code yet records the realized donor-support bounds of transported columns (the donor reader and transport operators, packages G3b and G5a), so no gate binding can read this evidence; activate it with a binding before any candidate release.
gates.notes: Every direct or derived calibration measure and every substantive Axiom input must carry a donor-support receipt.

Household weights must receipt their design-to-calibrated transition and destination-population mass change. Family scoring resolves those weights through Frame; it may not persist a second ambiguous vector.
No all-zero stored calibration layer, substantive Axiom input, geography layer, or provenance banner may ship.
No Axiom-derived rule output may persist as an input column and mask a baseline or reform calculation.
The source manifest is authoritative for physically non-negative weights, counts, days, periods, care units, and currency inputs.

gates.not_applicable: awaiting D1: the ex-ante NZ effective-sample-size floor (method card MC15) is not yet ruled.
gates.notes: Activate before a candidate release; never set the threshold from the candidate to make it pass.

gates.not_applicable: awaiting D1: the ex-ante NZ max-to-median weight-ratio threshold (method card MC15) is not yet ruled.
gates.notes: Activate before a candidate release; do not copy an empirical US, UK, Belgium, or Armenia fence.

gates.not_applicable: The Stats NZ national-accounts quantities, destination-unit candidate metrics, reviewed concept bridges, and low/high NZ bands are not yet packaged.
gates.notes: Activate broad income and expenditure backstops after evidence review. Treasury DistributionExplorer remains an external model comparator, not a macro target.
